description: This file defines a PHP class 'github' that provides a minimal implementation of GitHub API interactions, including methods for retrieving issues, comments, and repository info, primarily for integration with TestLink.

classes.name: github
classes.description: A PHP class for basic interactions with the GitHub REST API, supporting issue retrieval, comment management, and repository info.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the github object with URL, user, API key, owner, repo, and optional configuration.

methods.name: initCurl
methods.description: Sets up cURL with default options and proxy settings if provided.

methods.name: getIssueURL
methods.description: Retrieves the URL of a specific issue by its ID.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific issue.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific issue.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue with a title and body.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a comment to a specific issue.

methods.name: _get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the GitHub API.

methods.name: _request_json
methods.description: Performs an API request and decodes JSON response.

methods.name: _request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with specified method and handles response.
